concept.titleUz: Oddiy va zamonaviy idish – minimalist dizayn
concept.rationaleUz: Mahsulotning silliq kulrang yuzi va oq yorligʻi uning zamonaviy soddaligini koʻrsatadi. Toza studiya fonida, hech qanday ortiqcha elementlarsiz namoyish etish orqali idishning dizayn jozibasini taʻkidlaymiz.
concept.hookUz: Silliq kulrang tanasi va minimal oq yorliqli idish – zamonaviy koʻrinishda.

shots.descriptionUz: Oq fon ustida idish frontdan toʻliq kadrlanib turadi. Idish yengil burilish harakati bilan silliq sirtini namoyon qiladi.
shots.cameraUz: Statik frontal reja, engil lateral pan yoki yumshoq aylanma harakat idish atrofida.

shots.descriptionUz: Kamera yaqinlarga siljiydi, idishning oq yorliqli qismini yengil reflektiv yoritishda diqqat markazida koʻrsatadi.
shots.cameraUz: Sekin yaqinlashuvchi glide — kameraning oldinga oʻsi boʻyicha silliq siljishi.

shots.descriptionUz: Idish oʻrta masofada, toza va silliq yuzasi bilan keng kadrlanadi. Yorliqning noaniq (matnsiz) holati koʻzga tashlanadi. Qatʻiy minimalistik landshaft va yorqin yoritish.
shots.cameraUz: Statik yoki engil chekinuvchi kadr — idishni toʻliq oʻz aksida, markazda, toza fonga turganicha tutish.

result.promptEn:
Product reference and source of truth:
The single supplied reference image is the sole visual authority for the 'oddy idish'. The product must remain a vertically-oriented, cylindrical vessel with a smooth grey body and a prominent, centrally-placed white label area. The exact silhouette, the stark contrast between the grey exterior and white label, and the absence of any branding or additional details on the white area are crucial to its identity. No other product details are assumed besides those present in the image.

Product lock:
Any alteration to the grey color placement, cylindrical silhouette, or the shape and blankness of the central white label would break product identity. Do not add, enhance, or invent branding, text, decorative elements, new seams, or hardware. Do not reveal the top or bottom of the vessel. No invention of its interior or cross-section.

Commercial concept:
Celebrate the minimalist and modern charm of this unbranded dish by focusing on its smooth grey body and clean white label in an ultra-clean studio setup. The product is the center of attention, framed in a serene, clutter-free environment that conveys simplicity and sophistication.

Creative direction:
Ultra-clean, neutral-toned studio scene. The dish stands alone with no distraction, emphasizing purity of form and a contemporary design language. All cinematography decisions highlight the harmony between the grey surface and the central white label.

Opening hook:
Begin with a full-frontal shot of the dish against a pure white background. The product is upright, centered, and motionless for an instant, letting the viewer absorb its simple geometry and sharp contrast.

Camera:
Start with a static frontal, wide framing. Introduce a soft lateral pan to suggest its three-dimensionality without revealing unreferenced detail. For the close-up, employ a slow, forward camera glide. For the final hero shot, shift to a slightly withdrawn, centered framing with the product dominant.

Product motion:
The dish itself remains still for most of the sequence. In the first beat, allow for a slight rotational reveal (no more than visible sides), then keep it stationary to maintain focus on the existing features.

Environment:
A seamless, white studio background with diffuse, uninterrupted floor and wall. No props, text, or shadows besides those naturally cast by the product under soft lighting.

Lighting:
Use bright, diffuse studio lighting from each side, eliminating harsh shadows while emphasizing the dish's smooth surface and the exact edge of the white label. Allow for a gentle highlight that traces along the curvature to give a sense of depth,
but never introduce colored casts or unnecessary glare.

Material and texture treatment:
Maintain the product’s smooth, matte or satin appearance. The grey body reads as dense and even, with a soft sheen under studio lights. The white label should appear blank and slightly matte, without reflection or embossed edges.

Sequence:
1. (0-2.5s) Start with a wide frontal shot; the dish upright and perfectly centered, with a gentle left-to-right camera pan, pausing as the white label faces the camera. 
2. (2.5-5.5s) Camera glides in closer for a detailed look at the transition between the grey body and the clean white label, showing the subtle texture with no branding or text.
3. (5.5-8s) Pull back to a wider, static hero shot where the dish is again central, label clearly visible, surrounded by white negative space. Let the immaculate background and the product’s lines finish the visual statement.

Editing rhythm:
Calm, smooth pacing. Each transition is a direct, unobtrusive cut or gentle camera move—no aggressive editing, wipes, or light transitions; keep the rhythm aligned to the product’s stillness and the minimal theme.

Audio:
Ultra-subtle studio room tone, highlighting soft product handling foley if needed—a faint, realistic touch as the product rotates in the opening beat; otherwise, near-silence.

Hero ending:
Conclude with the product fully visible, label facing forward, filling the vertical frame’s center with clean negative space around it. No text or graphic overlays.

Visual quality:
Crisp, high-resolution studio lighting with natural soft shadows, no grain, haze, particles, or color grading that would affect the product’s appearance. Photorealism prioritized—edges are sharp, surface is clean, color and shadow preserved exactly as seen.

Fidelity requirements:
Maintain the cylindrical proportions, the smooth satin grey body, and the central blank white label area in every frame. Do not add or invent branding, text, or embellishments. Keep all camera movement gentle and never reveal unreferenced details such as the top, bottom, interior, or back. The spatial relationship between grey and white must remain unchanged. The product must always remain dominant and centered—never cropped or upstaged by props, hands, or background.

Avoidance:
Avoid high-energy or aggressive cinematography, invented logos or text, revealing parts of the product not visible in the reference, or introducing unnecessary props, overlays, or visual effects. Any guess at function, material, or brand would undermine the commercial’s simplicity and accuracy.
assumptionsUz: Bu idishning materiali nomaʻlum, shuning uchun silliq va mustahkam koʻrinish berildi.
Faqat old koʻrinish maʻlum, yuqori va pastki qismi yashirin.
reviewNotesUz: Yorliqdagi hech qanday matn yoki grafik detal yaratilmadi.
Idishning materiali haqida aniq dalil yoʻqligi sababli, neytral va silliq sirt sifati boʻyicha koʻrsatma berildi.
Hech qayerida brend nomi, logotip yoki bezak kiritilmadi.
